extracted.name: Slow Cooker Green Bean Casserole
extracted.description: This crockpot green bean casserole combines all the traditional ingredients in a slow cooker; top with French-fried onions for an easy and tasty side dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 (16 ounce) packages frozen cut green beans
2 (10.75 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Combine green beans, condensed soup, milk, Parmesan cheese, salt, black pepper, and 1/2 of the can of French-fried onions in a slow cooker.
Cover and cook on Low for 5 to 6 hours.
Top casserole with remaining French-fried onions to serve.
